scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/immersive-map && tsc -p apps/playground && tsc -p docs/guide && node scripts/check-guide.mjs
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p worker-wasm -p frame-wasm -p bench-wgpu -p bench-wasm -p layer-wasm -p model-wasm -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:shaders && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:rust && npm run test && npm run build:package
